name: Ligue 1
assumptions: The Coupe de France winner's Europa League place is assumed to pass down the table, so 5th and 6th go to the Europa League and 7th to the Conference League play-off round.
4th place enters the Champions League third qualifying round rather than the league phase; it is counted in the Champions League column and flagged in the tooltip.
16th place plays a two-legged relegation play-off against the Ligue 2 play-off winner; that play-off itself is not simulated.
Fair-play points are not available from the data source, so a tie that reaches that criterion is shown as unresolved.
